title: [2.7.3-dev] Inconsistency between TT-menu and Loop-menu concerning security
body:
I have enabled the biometric bolus and settings protection. If I want to set a temporary target, I have to provide my fingerprint but if I want to disable the loop, no fingerprint is required. I think that's inconsistent and the loop menu should also be protected.


System:
AndroidAPS 2.7.3-dev 1c8ed7b1a
Medtronic 554
Dexcom G6
xDrip+
Oneplus 3T
Lineage 17.1
